en.name: Chicken deli meat, pre-packaged
en.summary: Pre-packaged chicken deli meat is cooked breast — often oven-roasted and re-formed, sometimes labelled uncured — sliced, sealed and eaten straight from the pack, with nothing afterwards that would kill bacteria picked up since cooking. Sealed in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below it keeps 2 weeks from purchase, and 3–5 days after opening. Freezing is not recommended for quality; an unopened pack will hold 1–2 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F).
en.pantry: None. A pack of sliced chicken should go from the chiller cabinet to your own fridge with as little warm time in between as you can manage, and on a hot day an insulated bag is worth the trouble. The rules are strict because nothing happens to this meat between the packing line and your mouth: there is no cooking step left in which a mistake could be undone. Two hours is the outside limit at room temperature, dropping to 1 hour above 32 °C (90 °F), and that clock runs cumulatively — it does not reset each time the pack goes back in.
en.fridge: Sealed, 2 weeks from the purchase date at 4 °C (40 °F) or below; open it and you have 3–5 days. Keep the pack flat on a low shelf where the air is coldest and nothing raw can drip onto it. Deli chicken loses quality by a route of its own: cooked poultry develops what the trade calls warmed-over flavour, a flat cardboard staleness as the fat oxidises, and you usually taste that before you see anything. Slime on the surface, liquid gone cloudy and viscous, or any sour smell, and the pack goes in the bin. If the label says uncured, read that as a cure done with celery powder rather than as no cure at all; either way this is a ready-to-eat meat, and anyone pregnant, elderly or immunocompromised should heat it until steaming.
en.freezer: Not recommended. Sliced cooked chicken is thin enough to freeze and thaw quickly, which sounds like an advantage and is not: the slices come back limp and watery, the surface dries into leathery patches wherever air reached it, and the stale oxidised note arrives sooner in the freezer than it would have in the fridge. If you freeze it regardless, an unopened pack keeps 1–2 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F). Freeze it sealed and flat; if it is already open, stack the slices with greaseproof paper between them so you can lift out a few rather than chiselling apart a solid brick.
en.thawing: Overnight in the fridge, then use the slices hot — folded through a risotto, baked in a pie, pressed in a toasted sandwich. Counter thawing puts the outer slices into the danger zone long before the middle of the stack has softened. Once thawed, do not refreeze.
spoilage: A slimy or tacky film on the slices — the first and most reliable sign.
A sour, sulphurous or ammonia-like smell on opening.
Grey, green or iridescent patches, or dried dark edges.
A puffed pack, or liquid that has gone cloudy and ropy.
tips: Write the opening date on the pack; the opened window is far shorter than the unopened one.
Keep it on a cold shelf, never in the fridge door.
Take out what you need and reseal rather than leaving the pack open on the counter.
Heat until steaming if you are pregnant or immunocompromised.

faq.q: How long does packaged chicken deli meat keep?
faq.a: 2 weeks from purchase unopened in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, and 3–5 days once opened.
It is not recommended — the slices come back wet and soft. If you do, an unopened pack keeps 1–2 months from purchase at −18 °C, and the thawed meat is best used in a cooked dish.

faq.q: Why is deli meat a Listeria risk?
faq.a: It is eaten without further cooking, and Listeria can grow slowly even at refrigeration temperature. That is why the opened window is short and why vulnerable groups are told to heat it first.

zh.name: 包裝雞肉火腿片
zh.summary: 包裝雞肉火腿片是煮熟的雞胸肉——常見做法是烤過再重組成形，有些會標示無添加亞硝酸鹽——切片密封，拆開就直接吃，後面沒有任何步驟能殺死加熱之後才沾上的細菌。未開封自購買日起放 4 °C 以下 2 週，開封後 3～5 天。基於品質不建議冷凍；未開封的包裝在 −18 °C 下自購買日起 1～2 個月。
zh.pantry: 沒有。一包雞肉片應該從冷藏櫃直接進到你家冰箱，中間的常溫時間越短越好，夏天多帶一個保冷袋絕對值得。規則之所以這麼嚴，是因為這塊肉從包裝產線到你嘴裡什麼都沒發生：中間已經沒有任何加熱步驟可以把失誤補回來。室溫的極限是 2 小時，超過 32 °C 時降到 1 小時，而且這個時鐘是累計的，不會因為你把它冰回去就歸零。
zh.fridge: 未開封自購買日起放 4 °C 以下 2 週；開封後就是 3～5 天。整包平放在下層最冷的位置，上方不要有生食可能滴下來。雞肉片走下坡有它自己的路徑：煮熟的禽肉會產生所謂的回鍋味，那是脂肪氧化帶來的扁平紙板味，通常是先吃出來才看得出來。表面發黏、袋裡的湯汁變濁變稠，或聞到任何酸味，整包丟掉。標示如果寫著無添加亞硝酸鹽，請理解成改用芹菜粉做同一件事，而不是完全沒有醃製；不管哪一種，它都是即食肉，懷孕、年長或免疫功能低下者請加熱到冒蒸氣再吃。
zh.freezer: 不建議。熟雞肉片夠薄，凍得快也化得快，聽起來像優點，其實不是：解凍後肉片軟趴趴又出水，碰得到空氣的地方會乾成硬皮，脂肪氧化的紙板味在冷凍庫裡反而比在冷藏更早出現。真要凍，未開封的包裝在 −18 °C 下自購買日起 1～2 個月。沒開封就整包平放冷凍；已經開封的，在肉片之間夾一張烘焙紙再分裝，之後才能一次取幾片，不必整塊敲開。
zh.thawing: 放冷藏一晚解凍，然後趁熱用掉——拌進燉飯、包進派裡、夾成熱壓吐司。室溫退冰會讓外層先進入危險溫度帶，而那一疊的中間都還沒軟。解凍過就不要再冷凍。
spoilage: 肉片表面出現黏滑或發黏的薄膜——最早也最可靠的徵兆。
開封時聞到酸味、硫味或氨味。
出現灰色、綠色或虹彩光澤的斑，或邊緣乾黑。
包裝鼓脹，或滲出的汁液變混濁牽絲。
tips: 在包裝上寫開封日期，開封後的期限比未開封短得多。
放冷藏層架，絕對不要放冰箱門邊。
要用多少拿多少再封回去，不要整包開著放在檯面上。
懷孕或免疫功能低下者，請加熱到冒蒸氣再吃。

faq.q: 包裝雞肉火腿片可以放多久？
faq.a: 未開封自購買日起冷藏 4 °C 以下 2 週，開封後 3～5 天。
不建議，解凍後會濕軟。真要冷凍，未開封包裝在 −18 °C 下自購買日起 1～2 個月，解凍後最好用在加熱的料理。

faq.q: 為什麼即食熟肉有李斯特菌風險？
faq.a: 因為它不會再加熱就被吃掉，而李斯特菌在冷藏溫度下仍能緩慢生長。這就是開封後期限很短、也建議高風險族群先加熱的原因。
